propositions: Jira Data Center (self-hosted, REST v2, wiki markup, PAT auth, name-based identity) cannot be reconciled by the existing Cloud adapter (REST v3, ADF, ACLI subprocess, accountId auth)
Field maps, sanitizers, and shared logic are currently duplicated across adapters or forked in PR #120, creating drift and maintenance risk without a pinned contract

The two axes of variation (rich-text encoding and user identity model) must be parameterized as pinned contracts in a shared jira_family layer, with DC and Cloud each providing their own implementations

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) cannot physically relocate without updating the dynamic loader, so they must be shared by dependency inversion instead of file movement
A DC backend must enforce HTTPS with opt-in allow_insecure override, never disable TLS certificate verification, and read the PAT only from environment (JIRA_PAT), never from config files
Live bidirectional reconciliation against Jira 8.17.1 DC must be verified: DC-created issues must appear in the local store (inbound), and local edits must reach the DC instance (outbound)
